method.method_draft: First inspect the five candidate line graphs labeled A–E: each has years 1960, 1970, 1980, 1990 on the horizontal axis and percent marks 10, 20, 30 on the vertical axis. From the text, form the target plotted points: 1960 should be about 5%, 1970 about 8%, 1980 about 15%, and 1990 about 30%. Compare these four coordinates directly with each candidate. Reject A because it begins near 10% and has 1980 near 20%; reject B because 1980 is near 20% and 1990 is below 30%; reject C because 1980 is around 25%; reject D because 1980 is near 30%. Graph E is the one whose line is near 5, then just below 10, then around 15, then at 30, so choose E.
